verdict.rationale: Docs confirm snapshotting/persistence—sandboxes auto-save state on stop and can be resumed via a saved snapshot, avoiding re-setup (docs-11, docs-12, docs-28, docs-31, docs-18). However, the evidence only describes resuming the same sandbox, not explicitly forking multiple new sandboxes from one snapshot. Missing for 10: explicit fork/branch API or example creating multiple independent sandboxes from a single snapshot, and clearer API docs for snapshot naming/versioning.
